sentences.text: A volunteer group installed three solar lamps along the harbor path on Friday.
The lamps are meant to help evening walkers see the steps.
The public library added a printed walking map to its weekend notice board.
The map marks six accessible routes near the river.
Market vendors put up a blue canopy for Saturday's outdoor stalls.
Organizers expect twelve tables to join the market.
A neighborhood garden shared packets of native flower seeds at its monthly open day.
Visitors could take one packet while supplies lasted.
A repair shop reopened its clock workshop after replacing two workbenches.
The shop plans a free demonstration next Wednesday.
